LdapSettingsSchema.description:
LDAP connection and provisioning settings.

Nested under backend_settings.ldap in the offering configuration.

access_groups.description: LDAP groups to add new users to (e.g., VPN access, GPU access)
access_groups.title: Access Groups

account_source.description: Which side owns username/uidNumber/gidNumber/homeDirectory/loginShell. 'ldap' (default) keeps the historical behaviour: the agent derives usernames and allocates ids from the ranges below. 'waldur' takes all five from the offering user and writes them into the directory.

generate_vpn_password.description: Generate a random password for VPN access on user creation
generate_vpn_password.title: Generate Vpn Password

on_departure.description: What to do with the entry once it is released: 'disable' parks it (no-login shell, shadowExpire=1, groups dropped, marker set; same DN and uid come back on return) or 'delete' removes it. Unset, this follows account_source: 'disable' under 'waldur', 'delete' under 'ldap' (the historical meaning of remove_user_on_deactivate there).

on_missing_posix_ids.description: What to do when Waldur holds no UID/GID for an account. Only consulted when account_source is 'waldur'.

on_posix_mismatch.description: What to do when an existing entry's uidNumber/gidNumber disagree with Waldur's. Only consulted when account_source is 'waldur'.

personal_groups.description: Create a personal group (cn=<username> in groups_ou) with each account. Off, accounts carry the primary GID from Waldur and no group entry is written, so groups_ou is only needed for access_groups. Requires account_source 'waldur': without it there is no primary GID to write.
personal_groups.title: Personal Groups

project_groups.description: Write the service provider's project groups from Waldur

remove_user_on_deactivate.description: Delete the directory entry once the person holds no live account on any of the provider's offerings that share it. Unset, this follows account_source: off under 'ldap' (the entry is kept, as it always was), on under 'waldur' (Waldur owns the identity and keeps the ids, so the entry is reproducible and a departed user must not keep a resolvable login).
remove_user_on_deactivate.title: Remove User On Deactivate

user_group_object_classes.description: Object classes for personal user groups
user_group_object_classes.title: User Group Object Classes

username_format.description: Strategy for generating usernames from user profiles. Not permitted when account_source is 'waldur' - Waldur names the accounts.

waldur_username_attribute.description: LDAP attribute to store the Waldur username (e.g. a CUID) in, alongside the POSIX login name. Left unset, it is not written.
waldur_username_attribute.title: Waldur Username Attribute

welcome_email.description: SMTP settings for sending a welcome email on account creation. Disabled when not configured.

LdapSettingsSchema.title: LdapSettingsSchema

MissingPosixIdsPolicy.description: What to do when Waldur holds no UID/GID for an account.
MissingPosixIdsPolicy.title: MissingPosixIdsPolicy

ParentGroupConfig.description: An entry that lists the DNs of project groups (a cluster's groupOfNames).

attribute.description: Attribute that holds the project group DNs ('member', 'uniqueMember')
attribute.title: Attribute

PeriodicLimitsConfig.description:
Periodic-limits enablement settings (nested within ``backend_settings``).

Only fields the agent actually reads at runtime live here:

* ``enabled`` gates whether the agent subscribes to the
  ``RESOURCE_PERIODIC_LIMITS`` STOMP topic and runs
  ``apply_periodic_settings``.
* ``emulator_mode`` / ``emulator_base_url`` switch ``apply_periodic_settings``
  between sacctmgr writes and the SLURM emulator's REST API.
* ``limit_type`` is a fallback used when an inbound STOMP payload
  omits the explicit ``limit_type`` key.

Policy parameters (grace ratio, carryover factor, billing weights, raw
usage reset cadence, …) are authored on Mastermind's
``SlurmPeriodicUsagePolicy`` and arrive in the STOMP payload; the agent
applies what it receives, it does not configure those locally.

``extra="allow"`` lets deployments that still carry the legacy fields in
their YAML load without warning until they're cleaned up.

limit_type.description: Fallback SLURM limit type when the STOMP payload omits it

Opt-in: dedicated per-account QoS must not be replaced by qos_default/qos_paused/qos_downscaled. Default false keeps the classic QoS-swap pause/restore path.

UsageTresSource.description:
Which of a job's TRES its usage is billed on.

``requested`` is sacct's ReqTRES, ``allocated`` its AllocTRES. They differ
when the scheduler hands a job more than it asked for (whole cores on SMT
nodes, ``DefCpuPerGPU``, exclusive nodes), and only AllocTRES names the
GPU type picked for a request that did not name one.

settings_schema.description:
SLURM-specific backend settings validation.

Based on actual SLURM plugin usage patterns from backend.py analysis.
Home directory settings come from ``HomedirSettingsSchema``, shared with
every other backend that declares ``supports_user_homedirs``.

backend_id_max_retries.description: Attempts to find a unique backend id (default 50)
backend_id_max_retries.title: Backend Id Max Retries

check_all_offerings.description: Check backend id uniqueness against every offering, not only this one
check_all_offerings.title: Check All Offerings

check_backend_id_uniqueness.description: Check a new backend id against the offering's history
check_backend_id_uniqueness.title: Check Backend Id Uniqueness

cluster_name.description: SLURM cluster name to scope operations to. Optional in CLI mode, required when execution_mode is 'rest'.
cluster_name.title: Cluster Name

default_account.description: Default parent account in SLURM cluster
default_account.title: Default Account

default_account_policy.description:
Controls the DefaultAccount= argument passed to 'sacctmgr add user'.
  common     — use the configured default_account (current behaviour).
  individual — use the resource account itself; avoids implicit
               associations with the org-level root account.
  none       — the agent does not manage the default: DefaultAccount= is
               omitted and slurmdbd's own rule applies, which makes a new
               user's first association their default and leaves an
               existing user's default unchanged. An empty DefaultAccount
               is not a reachable state once any association exists.
default_account_policy.title: Default Account Policy

default_partition.description: Partition to assign to user-account associations (e.g., 'cn', 'common')
default_partition.title: Default Partition

enforce_offering_partitions.description: Thread the offering's partitions into user associations; when false they are informational only
enforce_offering_partitions.title: Enforce Offering Partitions

enforce_offering_qos.description: Override for per-offering QoS enforcement, applied only when qos_enforcement_enabled is True. None (default) respects each offering's plugin_options.enforce_qos; True forces enforcement; False forces informational mode.
enforce_offering_qos.title: Enforce Offering Qos

execution_mode.description: How to talk to SLURM: 'cli' (sacctmgr/sacct binaries, default) or 'rest' (slurmrestd REST API, including usage reporting; only RawUsage resets still run sacctmgr — see docs/slurm-rest-api-design.md)

homedir_base_path.description: Base path for user home directories (e.g. '/cephfs/home'). When set, quota is applied to {homedir_base_path}/{username}. When unset, the path is looked up from the system passwd database.
homedir_base_path.title: Homedir Base Path

homedir_quota.description: Filesystem quota settings for user home directories

hostname.description: Deprecated and ignored: the agent never reads it. Accepted so that configurations moved from an offering's plugin options validate
hostname.title: Hostname

ldap.description: LDAP directory for project groups and their GIDs (needs the waldur-site-agent-slurm[ldap] extra)

parent_account.description: Parent account for new project accounts. When set, accounts are created directly under this parent instead of the customer/project hierarchy.
parent_account.title: Parent Account

project_directory.description: Project directory creation and quota settings

qos_enforcement_enabled.description: Master opt-in for QoS enforcement on this agent. False (default) disables enforcement for every offering regardless of the remote plugin_options.enforce_qos flag. Set True to allow enforcement, then scope it with enforce_offering_qos / the per-offering flag.
qos_enforcement_enabled.title: Qos Enforcement Enabled

rest_api.description: slurmrestd connection settings, required when execution_mode is 'rest'

root_account.description: Account the top tier of the default hierarchy is created under (default: default_account, then 'root')
root_account.title: Root Account

slurm_bin_path.description: Directory the SLURM binaries (sacctmgr, sacct, scontrol, ...) are run from; in 'rest' mode, the RawUsage resets that still run sacctmgr. null runs them from $PATH
slurm_bin_path.title: Slurm Bin Path

soft_delete.description: On termination, keep the backend resource and only remove its users
soft_delete.title: Soft Delete

usage_tres_source.description: TRES that job usage is billed on, in both execution modes: 'requested' (sacct ReqTRES, default) or 'allocated' (sacct AllocTRES, falling back to ReqTRES for jobs that never started). 'allocated' attributes untyped GPU requests to the allocated gres/gpu:<type>, but also bills CPUs the scheduler added beyond the request
